# Managed Doom core

This directory vendors the platform-neutral engine source from
[sinshu/managed-doom](https://github.com/sinshu/managed-doom) at commit
`254fbab6257926616ecd3b7b8f99680f9661e2e6`.

The upstream `SFML` host is intentionally excluded. Usable Computer supplies a
Unity renderer and input adapter while retaining the original Managed Doom
license in `LICENSE.txt`.

No Doom IWAD or other game data is included.
